description: S3 Learning is "Uber for Learning" a platform that connects professionals with spare time to anyone seeking personalized, one-on-one guidance from real-world experts. Here's how it works: You can join S3 Learning either as a student looking to learn or as an instructor ready to share your expertise and earn money doing it. Our AI matching technology pairs the perfect instructor with each learner based on their specific needs.
problem_statement: AI is projected to create 78 million new jobs by 2030. For AI to be effective one would need domain knowledge. Baby boomers are retiring in huge numbers, taking decades of tribal knowledge with them from these critical fields. Additionally, traditional eLearning platforms see completion rates as low as 7%. S3learning is aimed at providing personalized learning from industry experts address both challenges and help retain domain knowledge and achieve higher completion rates.

team.justification: The team is led by a solo founder with guidance from a highly qualified board. While the founder lacks a co-founder, the board's expertise in multi-billion dollar companies provides strategic support. However, the small team size and lack of a co-founder may limit execution capacity.

company_assessment.market_positioning: S3learning differentiates itself by offering real-world expertise from industry practitioners, unlike competitors focused on academic backgrounds.
company_assessment.execution_capability: The team has just launched the product, indicating early execution capability, but lacks demonstrated scaling experience.
